scripts.dev:api: uv run --project services/api --no-sync uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir services/api --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765
scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm run build:sidecar && pnpm --filter @mozhou/desktop tauri dev
scripts.desktop:check: pnpm run build:sidecar && cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @mozhou/web lint && uv run --project services/api --no-sync ruff check services/api
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @mozhou/web typecheck && uv run --project services/api --no-sync mypy services/api/app
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run build && pnpm run desktop:check
